displayName: CP2 daily reporting job failed or did not succeed for 26 hours

documentation.content: The daily reporting job (cp2-reporting-daily) failed or has not succeeded for 26 hours. The website keeps showing the last approved data and marks it as needing a refresh. Check the latest execution log, then the planning/ runbooks.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "cp2-reporting-daily" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"

conditions.displayName: No successful reporting execution for 26 hours

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "cp2-reporting-daily" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "succeeded"
